description: Time the recorded cases on the original and on the built Rust module, bridge included; speedup below 1 means the port is slower as its callers call it. Returns the rows and a verdict with advice: ship, keep the slower functions, or port a bigger unit.

crate.description: Folder of the generated crate (holds rust-anything.json).

min_ms.description: Minimum measured time per function and side, in milliseconds (default 200).

resolve_from.description: Resolve npm packages the original imports from this folder's node_modules.
